problem: Prediction quality and contextual forecasts were visible, but the user could not see whether the whole Powerhouse self-improvement loop was actually learning and improving.
root_cause: The portal prediction endpoint projected forecast quality only; the canonical self-improvement control view was not included in the contextual foresight read model.
fix: Extend the authenticated prediction intelligence endpoint with the canonical self-improvement control projection and render it contextually on Overview and prediction-quality surfaces.
prevention_rule: Every material autonomous-learning capability must expose evidence of learning quality and promotion guardrails in the portal where decisions are made; code/model changes alone are never proof of improvement.

invariants: compound intelligence evidence is visible on contextual foresight surfaces
portal reads canonical self-improvement control instead of creating a parallel learning store
unknown or degraded state is never presented as green
